description: Alterations including erection of mansard roof extension to main rear roof and extension above part of two-storey back addition;  erection of part single, part two-storey rear/side extension; formation of roof terrace at first floor level with 1.7m high screen surround. Alterations and extensions in connection with conversion of dwelling into 2 x3 bedroom and 1 x2 bedroom flats.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed roof terrace, due to its siting, design and location, would be a prominent, visually intrusive and discordant feature that would fail to relate appropriately to the host building and local spatial character. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies LP1 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), and the Wandsworth Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 2 - The proposed roof terrace, due to its siting, design and location, would be an unneighbourly form of development that would result in a loss of privacy, increase in noise and disturbance, and a sense of overbearing for the residents of the neighbouring properties. By reason of its height and depth, the proposed single storey rear extension would be an overbearing and unneighbourly addition which would harm neighbouring amenity. The proposal therefore fails to accord with policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the guidance of the Wandsworth Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 3 - The proposal would fail to provide sufficient outlook or daylight/sunlight to habitable rooms for future occupiers of the development.  The proposed second/third floor flat fails to provide meet the minimum space standards for the number of intended occupiers. The proposal also fails to provide ceiling heights of 2.3m or more through 75% of the second/third floor flat's area.  The proposed development therefore fails to provide an acceptable standard of accommodation for future occupiers and is contrary to policies LP2 and LP27 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), the London Plan (2021) and Nationally Described Space Standards (2015).

Reason : 4 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
